title: MxJobsWMS portfolio optimization outcome
description: Returned by POST /optimize of the Layer 3 optimization services (portfolio-java, portfolio-cpp). Layer 2 decision agents read decisionContext to pick the next step.

solverStatus.description: optimal: converged; max_iterations: best point found, not converged; infeasible: constraints cannot be met (e.g. maxWeight * assets < 1); invalid_input: request rejected (see diagnostics.message).

weights.description: Asset → weight. Long-only, summing to 1, each at most maxWeight. Empty unless solverStatus is optimal or max_iterations.

volatility.description: Annualised standard deviation, as a fraction.

bindingConstraints.description: Constraints active at the solution: max_weight when an asset sits at the cap, long_only when an asset is at 0, max_turnover when turnover exceeds the requested maximum.

turnover.description: One-way turnover from currentWeights: ½ Σ |w − w₀|. Null when no currentWeights were sent.
